description: The tags of the tip's two public logs: compute_log_tag(chain_request_id, domain) of protocol_types v6.0.0, poseidon2_hash_with_separator([chain_request_id], domain), with domain a u32. REQUEST_DOMAIN tags the on-chain request log that intake emits; PSS_STATE tags the sealed-thirds log that apply emits in state mode chain. Tags computed by aztec.js 6.0.0 (computeLogTag of @aztec-labs/stdlib/hash). Read by sidecar-core tests/vectors.rs, sidecar-tip src/chain/layout.rs and src/state/chain.rs (the constants) and pss-client test/vectors.test.ts; noir/pss_public_contract defines the same two domains in Noir (REQUEST_DOMAIN in domains.nr, PSS_STATE in chain_state.nr).
